Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted Julia Crawford Ivers’s birth year by “standardizing” ‘67 to 1967 instead of 1867, despite sources showing 1867/1869. This led to an incorrect chronological comparison and the wrong conclusion that Ivers (1867/1869) was born later than T. V. Chandran (1950). The error combined a faulty normalization of conflicting data and a basic logical mistake in comparing years.
